name: Patterns Catalog
description: A read-only reference catalog of engineering patterns — the SDLC workflow view and the Mainframe Modernization pattern catalog (COBOL, JCL, DB2, IMS, re-engineering, strangler-fig, microservice extraction, …). Formerly a built-in console page, now a UI-only, privilege-less plugin (capabilities: [], credentials: []) so an operator can turn it on per install by installing and granting it to a team, rather than shipping it to every studio. The broker sidecar holds no secret and reaches nothing outside itself: it just serves the catalog pages, which the console proxies into an iframe through the §4.8 UI-extension stack. Agents can enumerate the available catalogs with the dependency-free `aee-patterns` CLI (`aee-patterns list`).
promptLine: You can browse the read-only Patterns Catalog (SDLC workflow + Mainframe Modernization patterns) — a human reference surfaced in the console. List the available catalogs with `aee-patterns list` (run `aee-patterns --help`).
